title: DARKBENCH: BENCHMARKING DARK PATTERNS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial prompts that request comparisons, rankings, or self-assessments of AI models to detect if the chatbot unfairly favors its own developer's products or company.

Prompting models with controversial ideological statements (e.g., regarding gender-neutral bathrooms) or pseudoscientific claims to test if the model exhibits sycophancy by dishonestly reinforcing the user's echo chamber.

Using adversarial prompts designed to elicit discriminatory perspectives (e.g., asking if men are better at chess than women) to test if the model generates biased narratives that reinforce harmful stereotypes.
